itinerary.title: Canton, GA to Little Rock, AR (Hotel 1)
itinerary.hotel: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Little Rock-West
itinerary.target: Establish a clean interstate baseline west on I-75/I-24/I-40 while clearing Nashville and Memphis during off-peak windows.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: Canton, GA → 1165 AEDC Rd, Hillsboro, TN 37342 (148 miles, approx. 2 hrs 35 mins)
legs.operational_notes: GA-20 W to I-75 N through Chattanooga, over Monteagle on I-24 W. Gains 1 hour across time zone line (EDT to CDT). Plan a 30-minute fueling and staging break at Love's #764 upon arrival.

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 1165 AEDC Rd, Hillsboro, TN 37342 → 2050 Highway 70 E, Jackson, TN 38305 (196 miles, approx. 3 hrs 05 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Traverses Nashville via I-24 to I-440 W bypass to I-40 W around 9:15 AM (past peak morning rush). Follows I-40 W directly to Love's Travel Stop in Jackson (Exit 87). Plan a 30-minute lunch and fueling break.

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 2050 Highway 70 E, Jackson, TN 38305 → 4900 Talley Road, Little Rock, AR 72204 (224 miles, approx. 3 hrs 25 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Crosses the Mississippi River at Memphis around 1:00 PM (midday lull) straight into Little Rock on I-40 W. Arrives at Day 1 hotel destination ahead of evening rush.
legs.destination_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Little Rock-West

itinerary.title: Little Rock, AR to Tucumcari, NM (Hotel 2)
itinerary.target: Clear Oklahoma City bottleneck during the mid-day commuter dead zone.

legs.name: Morning Stretch
legs.route_details: 4900 Talley Rd, Little Rock, AR 72204 → 903 E Trudgeon St, Henryetta, OK 74437 (248 miles, approx. 3 hrs 35 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Early departure avoids local Little Rock morning commuter buildup. Staging and fueling break at QuikTrip (Exit 237).
legs.start_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Little Rock-West

legs.name: Midday Run
legs.route_details: 903 E Trudgeon St, Henryetta, OK 74437 → 301 S 4th St, Sayre, OK 73662 (218 miles, approx. 3 hrs 12 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Passes through the heart of Oklahoma City at approximately 11:15 AM, hitting the optimal lunch-hour lull. Plan a 30-minute break at Southbound Quickstop (Phillips 66) at Exit 20.

legs.name: Evening Stretch
legs.route_details: 301 S 4th St, Sayre, OK 73662 → 1901 S Mountain Rd, Tucumcari, NM 88401 (239 miles, approx. 3 hrs 27 mins)
legs.operational_notes: Straightforward tracking along I-40 W directly into the Day 2 overnight hotel location (Fairfield Inn & Suites).
legs.destination_name: Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott Tucumcari

itinerary.title: Tucumcari, NM to Flagstaff, AZ (Hotel 3)

legs.operational_notes: A slightly delayed departure allows Albuquerque's morning rush hour to dissolve entirely before your arrival. 30-minute fueling break at Maverik #621.
legs.destination_address: 650 Juan Tabo Boulevard NE, Albuquerque, NM 87123

legs.name: Midday Run

legs.start_address: 650 Juan Tabo Boulevard NE, Albuquerque, NM 87123

legs.name: Evening Stretch

itinerary.title: Redding, CA to Canyonville, OR (Home)
itinerary.target: Secure optimal visibility and warmer road conditions through mountain passes.

legs.name: Final Leg
legs.route_details: 1195 Grand Ave, Redding, CA 96003 → 561 Mill St, Canyonville, OR 97417 (215 miles, approx. 3 hrs 33 mins)
legs.operational_notes: No urban gridlock risks. Leaving at 09:00 AM maximizes daylight safety, thermal road traction, and line-of-sight visibility over the mountain grades back home.
